today = datetime.date.today() records = env['x_control_de_desecho'].search([ ('x_studio_active', '=', True), ('x_studio_next_date', '>=', datetime.datetime.combine(today, datetime.time.min)), ('x_studio_next_date', '<=', datetime.datetime.combine(today, datetime.time.max)), ]) for record in records: product = record.x_studio_product_product locations = record.x_studio_warehouse if not product: continue if not locations: continue # Cachear como string ANTES del bucle: si un scrap falla y la caché # del producto se invalida, el message_post al final seguirá funcionando. product_name = product.display_name errors = [] # acumular errores para postear UN solo mensaje al final # 🔹 Agrupar stock por ubicación en UNA sola query quant_data = env['stock.quant'].read_group( [ ('product_id', '=', product.id), ('location_id', 'in', locations.ids), ('quantity', '>', 0) ], ['quantity:sum'], ['location_id'] ) for quant in quant_data: location_id = quant['location_id'][0] total_qty = quant['quantity'] if total_qty <= 0: continue # SAVEPOINT manual con SQL (en safe_eval `with` está prohibido). # Nombre único por record + location para evitar colisiones. sp_name = "sp_scrap_%s_%s" % (record.id, location_id) env.cr.execute("SAVEPOINT " + sp_name) try: scrap = env['stock.scrap'].create({ 'product_id': product.id, 'scrap_qty': total_qty, 'location_id': location_id, 'company_id': record.x_studio_company.id, 'origin': record.display_name, }) scrap.action_validate() # Éxito: liberamos el savepoint env.cr.execute("RELEASE SAVEPOINT " + sp_name) except Exception as e: # Fallo: rollback al savepoint deja la transacción exterior sana env.cr.execute("ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT " + sp_name) errors.append((location_id, str(e))) #
